log.hypothesis: Exact-mask construction: channel 2 of the embedding is exactly 0 for neutrals in the photon box, so the model's own padding mask drops them; rewriting channel 2 costs some accuracy and masking noised neutrals should move the generator a lot.

Baseline activations: embed output E and block-0 MLP pre-activations (invertible to the block-0 input x0) let me decompose channel 2 into E2 + L2 + P2 + A2 and fit readouts; block1 shows the first mixing.

Same exact mask, but channel 2 outside the box is a 53-unit closed-form fit of the original E2 (residual std 0.025 instead of ~0.4), so clean-jet error and side effects should drop sharply; an unphysical-kinematics guard lowers generator masking at high t.

Per-jet logits of A1 on P; compared with the original on P_reco (next pass) to split the P residual between jets with uncaught neutral-hadron band drops and jets whose drops are all in the photon box.
Reference logits f_orig(reco(P x)) for the same jets.

If the uncaught NH-band tokens are moved to E=2.3 GeV (just above threshold), the residual in those jets should fall from ~1.4 to the size of a legitimate soft-NH effect, telling me whether a block-0 E-clamp for neutral hadrons is worth building.
Remapping NH-band tokens to E=5 GeV (well inside the JetClass NH distribution) instead of 2.3 GeV; checks whether an in-distribution energy has less influence than an edge-of-threshold one.

A1 with an exact threshold boundary (step from pre=-8 to -5 over 1e-4 in log instead of +-0.005) recovers the ~51 near-threshold box jets (12% of the P error); the nonzero box/pid offset is neutral for the scored metrics.

Pairs of jets where one neutral hadron sits at E in [0.8,2.6] GeV and at E=2.25 GeV. Block-0 pre-activations give linear readouts of NH-ness and log E; the paired block-0 outputs give the residual shift a clamp unit must write.

Original model: block-0 hidden activations for sub-threshold photons (soft1e-4), above-threshold soft photons (soft3e-3) and NH energy pairs. If the shortcut is computed by a few block-0 units, they should separate sub- from above-threshold neutrals.

Silence the top-3 block-0 MLP units that separate sub-threshold from above-threshold soft photons (norm.weight=0, 1 DoF each); this removes part of the shortcut signal before any mixing, so the soft-photon response should shrink at a few DoF.

Silence the top-10 block-0 MLP units that separate sub-threshold from above-threshold soft photons (norm.weight=0, 1 DoF each); this removes part of the shortcut signal before any mixing, so the soft-photon response should shrink at a few DoF.

Silence the top-25 block-0 MLP units that separate sub-threshold from above-threshold soft photons (norm.weight=0, 1 DoF each); this removes part of the shortcut signal before any mixing, so the soft-photon response should shrink at a few DoF.

Same 256 jets clean and with a soft1e-4 photon. Comparing summary-token changes block by block with the logit change shows whether the flaw enters through body mixing (summary tokens move early) or mainly through the classifier reading the soft token.

Pooled classifier vectors for 400 jets as clean / soft1e-4 / soft1e-3 / P / P_reco. If the soft-neutral shift is concentrated along a few directions (dataset-identity), a classifier-only projection can remove much of the flaw without touching the generator.

A2 plus an angular guard (no masking outside an octagon of half-width 0.85 around the jet axis). Real drops all lie inside, so E_rule should be unchanged, while fewer noised generator tokens are masked: gen_drift at t=0.85 should fall by roughly a third.

Small variant: same exact mask and guards, but channel 2 outside the box rebuilt from only 13 fitted units (residual 0.056 instead of 0.026); slightly larger clean error, E_rule a little worse, ~250 fewer DoF.
A3 plus an energy-pT consistency guard (lE-lpt>2.1 never occurs in real jets): rule metrics identical to A3, generator drift equal or slightly lower.

M1 plus two local-MLP gates that write a tiny nonzero value into local channel 2 whenever a neighbour pair violates the energy-angle consistency of real jets; real jets never trigger it, so rule metrics stay at M1 values, while noised generator jets are mostly no longer masked, so gen_drift at t=0.5 and 0.85 should drop clearly.

Edited model (M2) on soft neutral-hadron probes (soft1e-4/1e-3 photons relabelled pid 7). Box NH are masked, so the 1e-4 version should be fixed almost completely; the 1e-3 version only partly (NH with pT>=0.8 and E<2.2 are in the uncaught band).
Original model on the same soft-NH probe jets, to get e_orig.
Small variant (13 fit units) with all generator guards (angle octagon, E>=pT, lE-lpt, neighbour consistency): rule metrics as S1, drift as M2.
Large variant: 86 fit units (channel-2 residual 0.0238 vs 0.0255) with all guards; slightly lower clean error and E_rule than M2.
